"Patna Junction & Mithapur Flyover: 4K Drone View (2026 Development Update)"
Witness a breathtaking 4K aerial view of Patna's transformation! This drone footage captures the bustling Patna Junction Railway Station and the architectural curves of the Mithapur Flyover from a perspective you’ve never seen before.
Patna Junction: The heart of Bihar's railway network in full motion.
Mithapur Flyover: Stunning top-down shots of one of the city's busiest overbridges.
Urban Growth: A bird's-eye view of South Patna’s expanding skyline and infrastructure.
